turns.q: My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
turns.replyTail:
really sorry your order arrived damaged.

Please log in so we can look up your order and help with the next steps. If your item arrived damaged, please contact us within 7 days of delivery with clear photos of the damage. For minor issues, we may offer a partial refund of up to 10%. For significant damage or if the item is not as described, we can offer a full refund or replacement, including return postage costs.

Once you’re logged in, we’ll take it from there 💛
